checks.name: Default finalizer remains immediate exact endpoint deletion and same retained phase close
Checkpoint waits only after exact financial cleanup, disabled readback and both fixture archives
Strict acknowledgement binds exact phase, endpoint, canonical verified event, 2xx, time and artifact
Acknowledgement never manufactures a missing signed receipt or canonical Checkout acceptance
Wrong input remains unaccepted and unrecorded until a later matching acknowledgement
EOF cleans up the same endpoint and reports missing review instead of success
Ten-minute timeout also cleans up with no review acceptance or budget reset
A re-enabled or repurposed endpoint during review is not deleted after stale readback
Unknown DELETE remains reserved, identity retained and no blind second DELETE occurs
Archive failure skips the wait, retains failure and completes exact endpoint cleanup
Checkpoint adds one fresh GET but fits unchanged ten cleanup attempts after thirty spent
Exhausted physical allowance cannot turn acknowledged review into endpoint deletion
Expired phase still retains original cleanup authority without another Checkout or subscription
